data.long_meaning: The name Afiakh is derived from the Arabic word ‘afthah’ which means ‘dry fig’. In Islamic culture, figs are considered a symbol of abundance and blessings. Therefore, the name Afiakh is believed to bring prosperity and fertility to those who bear it. The name Afiakh carries the meaning “Dry Fig” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Afiakh usually hope their child will grow to embody dry fig and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Afiakh belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Dry Fig.”
